clusters.mechanism: pushBranch and pushExistingBranch in src/git/repos.ts (delivery and land-queue pushes) still honor repository-scoped config (command settings, URL rewrites, ext transport), so planted repo config executes commands.
The land-pr.sh config allowlist rejects harmless local settings (user.name, user.email, extra remotes), so ordinary repositories are refused landing.
The expanded land-pr integration tests spawn extra subprocesses and exceed Bun's default 5000ms timeout, so they fail unless given a longer timeout.
The config snapshot/comparison in land-pr.sh is taken before the push, leaving a race: a surviving process can change repo config after validation, and the push rereads it and executes the command.
The rejection message prints config key names verbatim, leaking credentials embedded in URL-scoped credential key subsections to stderr.
